note: H238: stranded.sh v2 decided whether a file had a LIVE EDITOR without reading any liveness input, and IN-FLIGHT -- the verdict that tells the fleet to stand off -- was the absorbing state for a dead lane. v3 reads .loop_lock/.heartbeat and adds UNATTENDED. THE REPAIR IS SILENT ON TODAY'S TREE (UNATTENDED 0, every rostered lane beating), which is exactly why the defect survived unmeasured.

controls.name: C1_baseline_really_is_v2
controls.must_fire_because: the baseline is resolved by walking this file s history for the newest blob whose OWN HEADER says v2, and both versions are read back from their headers. The first draft compared sha256s only: once the repair LANDED, `git show HEAD:` returned v3, the "before" column became v3 and A2 printed a verdict v2 cannot produce -- a NECESSARY condition read as a SUFFICIENT one
controls.can_fail_because: no commit carries a v2 header, or the candidate still does; probe2 exits 2 and publishes no delta

controls.name: C2_live_branch_is_reachable
controls.must_fire_because: a real running process renamed via `exec -a` so `ps -o command=` reads a run_loop.sh -- without it v3's LIVE branch is unreachable in the fixture and every other arm proves nothing (A15 inside the fix for A15)
controls.can_fail_because: `exec -a` is unavailable or the spin-wait times out, in which case probe2 exits 2

controls.name: C3_stranded_and_noowner_still_reachable
controls.must_fire_because: the repair added a verdict; the other three must still fire, or the vocabulary lost a branch while gaining one
controls.can_fail_because: v3 collapsed a branch into UNATTENDED

controls.name: C4_suite_can_go_red
controls.must_fire_because: 8 mutants each delete one part of the repair and --selfcheck must refuse each; a check nobody has seen fail is not a check. M8 (v3.1/H243) is the source line for the shared predicate: drop it and LIVE becomes unreachable
controls.can_fail_because: a mutant stays green, naming an inert assertion

falsifiers.name: F1_verdict_now_varies_with_liveness
falsifiers.can_fail_because: one arm, identical in every input but owner liveness, changes verdict IN-FLIGHT -> UNATTENDED
falsifiers.refutes: that v3 is as blind as v2
falsifiers.fires_when: one arm, identical in every input but owner liveness, changes verdict IN-FLIGHT -> UNATTENDED

falsifiers.name: F2_in_flight_no_longer_absorbing
falsifiers.can_fail_because: v2 reads IN-FLIGHT at 1m/1h/1d/30d and v3 reads none of them IN-FLIGHT
falsifiers.refutes: that IN-FLIGHT is still a dead lane's permanent answer
falsifiers.fires_when: v2 reads IN-FLIGHT at 1m/1h/1d/30d and v3 reads none of them IN-FLIGHT

falsifiers.name: F3_stale_beat_still_defers
falsifiers.can_fail_because: the stale-beat arm stays IN-FLIGHT under v3
falsifiers.refutes: that the repair calls a rate-limited live lane dead -- the direction that would tell a lane to touch live work
falsifiers.fires_when: the stale-beat arm stays IN-FLIGHT under v3

falsifiers.name: F4_disarms_without_apparatus
falsifiers.can_fail_because: the no-third-party arm stays IN-FLIGHT under v3
falsifiers.refutes: that UNATTENDED fires where no lane produces liveness artifacts at all (a fresh clone, a non-fleet machine)
falsifiers.fires_when: the no-third-party arm stays IN-FLIGHT under v3

falsifier: the retired-owner arm staying IN-FLIGHT under v3, or the stale-beat arm escalating, or a mutant of the repair passing --selfcheck
